class Particle:
    """A tiny record we will create in huge numbers."""
    __slots__ = ("x", "y", "mass")

    def __init__(self, x, y, mass):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.mass = mass

p = Particle(1.0, 2.0, 0.5)
# __slots__ replaces the per-object dict with fixed storage slots.
print(hasattr(p, "__dict__"))
